thread:
sara_sales: Heads-up — Meridian POC kickoff next Tue. They want a drop-in compatibility layer for RivalAPI, prompt parity checks, identical billing semantics for the first 6 months, and a security questionnaire answered before kickoff. Can @tom_se, @avi_engineer, @nina_sec join?

tom_se: On it. Quick Qs: do we have their example payloads yet? and what latency SLO are they asking for?

avi_engineer: I can take the shim work. Important to confirm streaming frames and tool-calling semantics — RivalAPI streams with chunked JSON frames and uses an embedded "tool_call" field. If we don't mirror that exactly clients will break.

sara_sales: They sent a sample of 120 requests and a PDF sec questionnaire. Latency SLO: p95 <= 300ms for conversational endpoints. Also procurement wants pricing parity for FY1 and a DPA addendum.

nina_sec: I'll own the questionnaire. I'll need a few config answers: KMS options (we support customer-managed KMS), data residency (we can pin region), retention policy (default 30d, can be extended). I'll review the PDF and post answers by Tue EOD.

avi_engineer: Notes from implementation side:
- Tokenization differences are real — RivalAI appears to bill tokens differently for whitespace vs byte-pair. We'll re-run their tokenization on their eval set and generate a billing reconciliation report rather than changing our meter.
- Error semantics: they expect 429 for rate-limits with Retry-After header. We'll translate internal 503/500 to that only when it's a quota throttle.

sara_sales: Meridian also asked for a canary rollout and fallback rules documented in the SOW. They want us to guarantee no more than 2% response divergence on their 1k prompt eval set.

tom_se: Proposed presales plan:
1) Build a shim prototype that maps Rival endpoints to our API.
2) Run side-by-side eval on their 1k prompts, produce diffs, token-cost reconciliation, and a latency heatmap.
3) Offer 6-month parity pricing: credit to cover delta up to a threshold, then true-up monthly.

avi_engineer: Prototype mapping example (PoC snippet):
```
# shim pseudocode
POST /rival/v1/generate -> /redwood/v1/generate
headers: X-Rival-Quota -> x-rw-quota
body.mapping: rival_prompt -> input.prompt
stream: chunked-json -> chunked-ndjson
```
I'll put a containerized PoC on the staging workspace.

nina_sec: For security Qs I'll need answers around: encrypted-at-rest (AES-256), in-transit (TLS1.2+), KMS rotation, SOC2 status, access logs retention, and pen-test cadence. I'll draft those and share. If legal needs the DPA template, ping @sara_sales.

sara_sales: Also flagging billing: Meridian wants invoice-level visibility matching Rival line items (prompt tokens, completion tokens, requests). Can we generate a CSV with per-request breakdown and token mapping?

tom_se: Yes — we'll produce a reconciliation file that maps our tokens -> their billed tokens and a delta column. That will live in S3 and we can share a signed URL for procurement.

deploy_bot: deploy-bot: Created workspace "onramp-meridian" for this POC — https://console.redwood/workspaces/onramp-meridian :white_check_mark: 

avi_engineer: Action items: PoC shim container by Wed (2012348000), eval harness + 1k prompt run by Fri, will push results to the workspace.

nina_sec: I'll post initial sec answers Tue EOD and schedule a 30-min sync with Meridian's security team if they want deeper review.

sara_sales: I'll draft SOW + pricing pitch (6-month parity credit, ops runbook, escalation path) and share for comments. Thanks team — let's aim to have the first demos ready next week. :rocket:
